acceptanceObjective: EmbodiedCoordinator arbitrates by priority: a strictly higher-priority request deterministically preempts conflicting lower-priority active requests through the normal cancel path; equal or lower priority stays rejected as resource-busy; disjoint-resource holders keep running in parallel; production admission keeps Priority=0 so runtime behavior is unchanged.
notes: Deferred queued admission (auto-start when resources free) and old action entry migration remain out of scope; production runtime requests all use Priority=0 so no runtime behavior change is permitted by this package.
